title: How the QC Report Looks
use_cases: Use when interpreting quality control results to determine if manual intervention is required
Configure when defining threshold rules for automatic data correction
Use when reviewing flagged inconsistencies in the system dashboard
Implement when auditing system-wide data integrity against defined world rules
content:
Each check produces a structured verdict:

| Severity | Meaning | Action |
| --- | --- | --- |
| PASS | Everything consistent | No correction needed |
| WARNING | Possible inconsistency, not clear-cut | Flagged for manual review |
| FAIL | Clear contradiction against inventory or world rules | Triggers automatic correction |

You can see the full QC report in the dashboard and judge warnings yourself. For failures, the next step kicks in automatically.
